snippet.title: 1001 Nights: The Adventures of Sindbad
snippet.description:
1001 Nights: The Adventures of Sindbad for PC: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7219/1001-nights-the-adventures-of-sindbad/index.html

Help the lovely Princess Chalida locate the seven gems of her royal crown and break the curse that has trapped her in a body of wood! Find Hidden Objects, identify specific spots in each scene, and overcome powerful guardians as you seek out the precious stones. Along the way you'll have to solve dozens of clever riddles and beat eight challenging minigames, in 1001 Nights: The Adventures of Sinbad!

  * Multiple minigames
  * Dazzling graphics
  * Find the precious stones!
  * Check out our complete game walkthrough at http://www.bigfishgames.com/blog/1001-nights-the-adventures-of-sinbad-walkthrough/
